**This repository is not accepting pull requests.**

It is published as a record of completed work rather than as a collaborative project. Issues are
disabled, and pull requests are not reviewed or merged.

If you have found a factual error, a broken link, or a security concern, contact me at the email address in the README instead of
opening a pull request. Reports are genuinely welcome through that route.
